// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  app/_nav.scss — the nav bar itself: section links, the logo button's
//  plasma-fire underline (filament + halo + flicker keyframes), the
//  --on-dark variant, separators and the language pill group.
//  Imported by app.scss (manifest) — uses $_B_NAV defined there.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// The nav bar itself: logo + section links left/center, burger + flag + prefs triggers right.
.nav {
  @extend %MAXAREA;
  z-index: 100;
  left: 0;
  top: var(--space-lg);
  position: fixed;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  cursor: pointer;
  pointer-events: auto;

  &-link {
    @extend %TTL_BASE;
    @extend %TTL_XS;
    @extend %RESETBTN;

    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--grey-3);
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition:
      opacity 0.3s ease-in,
      color 0.2s ease;
    position: relative;

    &:hover,
    &:focus {
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    &.router-link-exact-active,
    &.active {
      color: var(--black);
      font-weight: 700;

      &::after {
        display: block;
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        bottom: calc(-1 * var(--space-2xs));
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: var(--space-2xs);
        border-radius: var(--space-hairline);
        background: var(--grey);
      }
    }

    &.selected-work {
      cursor: n-resize;
    }

    &.scroll-down {
      cursor: s-resize;
    }
  }

  // Logo interaction mirrors animated content links: DrawText replays its
  // word wrappers first, then this parent-owned underline sweeps in. Active
  // home state keeps the line landed, matching the other active nav links.
  // The line is a plasma-fire discharge, not a flat bar: ::after paints the
  // white-hot filament core traveling along the track while ::before is the
  // blurred ionized sheath glowing behind it — both run a slow drift plus an
  // irregular brightness flicker so the edge reads as living plasma.
  &-logo-btn {
    opacity: 1;

    &::after,
    &::before {
      display: block;
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: calc(-1 * var(--space-2xs));
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      border-radius: var(--space-hairline);
      transform: scaleX(0);
      transform-origin: left center;
      transition: transform 0.35s ease;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    &::after {
      height: var(--space-2xs);
      background: var(--plasma-line);
      background-size: 280% 100%;
      background-repeat: no-repeat;
      box-shadow:
        0 0 var(--space-xs) var(--plasma-glow-near),
        0 0 var(--space-md) var(--plasma-glow-far);
    }

    &::before {
      height: var(--space-md);
      bottom: calc(-1 * var(--space-sm));
      background: var(--plasma-halo);
      background-size: 280% 100%;
      background-repeat: no-repeat;
      filter: blur(var(--space-2xs));
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    &:hover,
    &:focus-visible,
    &:active {
      opacity: 1;

      &::after,
      &::before {
        transform: scaleX(1);
      }
    }

    &.router-link-exact-active,
    &.active {
      &::after,
      &::before {
        transform: scaleX(1);
      }
    }

    // Plasma runs only while the line is landed — smooth, subtle drift
    // without harsh opacity flickering.
    &:hover::after,
    &:focus-visible::after,
    &:active::after,
    &.router-link-exact-active::after,
    &.active::after {
      animation: #{$_B_NAV}-plasma-drift 3.5s linear infinite;
    }

    &:hover::before,
    &:focus-visible::before,
    &:active::before,
    &.router-link-exact-active::before,
    &.active::before {
      animation: #{$_B_NAV}-plasma-drift 5s linear infinite reverse;
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      &:hover::after,
      &:focus-visible::after,
      &:active::after,
      &.router-link-exact-active::after,
      &.active::after,
      &:hover::before,
      &:focus-visible::before,
      &:active::before,
      &.router-link-exact-active::before,
      &.active::before {
        animation: none;
      }
    }
  }

  // Plasma travel — the filament band slides along the track forever;
  // transparent gradient tails make the wrap invisible (emitted at root).
  @keyframes #{$_B_NAV}-plasma-drift {
    from {
      background-position-x: 200%;
    }

    to {
      background-position-x: 0%;
    }
  }

  // Discharge flicker — irregular opacity stops read as arc instability,
  // not a metronome pulse. Opacity only so the halo's static blur filter
  // is never overridden (emitted at root).
  @keyframes #{$_B_NAV}-plasma-flicker {
    0%,
    100% {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    11% {
      opacity: 0.82;
    }

    24% {
      opacity: 0.96;
    }

    39% {
      opacity: 0.74;
    }

    53% {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    67% {
      opacity: 0.87;
    }

    82% {
      opacity: 0.93;
    }
  }

  // Heat shimmer — brightness surges on the core only (it carries no blur
  // to clobber); the halo keeps its own pulse rhythm (emitted at root).
  @keyframes #{$_B_NAV}-plasma-heat {
    0%,
    100% {
      filter: brightness(1);
    }

    17% {
      filter: brightness(1.35);
    }

    34% {
      filter: brightness(0.9);
    }

    58% {
      filter: brightness(1.5);
    }

    76% {
      filter: brightness(1.1);
    }
  }

  // Nav over dark surfaces (contact section / page bottom) — swap ink for light greys
  &--on-dark {
    .#{$_B_NAV}-link {
      color: var(--grey-2);

      &.router-link-exact-active,
      &.active {
        color: var(--color-white-raw);
      }
    }

    .#{$_B_NAV}-separator {
      color: var(--text-muted-on-dark);
    }

    .#{$_B_NAV}-lang-btn.active {
      color: var(--color-white-raw);
    }

    .#{$_B_NAV}-burger-fallback {
      &:before,
      &:after,
      .#{$_B_NAV}-burger-line {
        background: var(--grey-2);
      }
    }
  }

  &-separator {
    @extend %TTL_BASE;
    @extend %TTL_XS;

    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    padding: 0 to-rem(10);
  }

  // ── Language selector pill group ─────────────────────────────────────────
  &-lang {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem(4);
  }

  &-lang-btn {
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    opacity: 0.45;
    transition:
      opacity 0.2s ease,
      color 0.2s ease;

    &:hover,
    &:focus {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    &.active {
      opacity: 1;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);

      &::after {
        display: block;
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        bottom: calc(-1 * var(--space-2xs));
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: var(--space-2xs);
        border-radius: var(--space-hairline);
        background: var(--grey);
      }
    }
  }
}
